blocks.passage:
Change is normal in business. A new tool, a new process, a new manager, a new team — change happens all the time.

At the beginning, change can feel uncomfortable. We know the old way. The new way feels slower. But after a few weeks, the new way becomes the normal way.

A positive attitude helps. Ask questions, try the new tool, share what works. A small smile goes a long way during change.

items.q: How often does change happen in business?
items.why: "change happens all the time."

items.q: How can change feel at the beginning?
items.why: "At the beginning, change can feel uncomfortable."

items.q: What happens after a few weeks?
options: The new way stays hard forever
The new way becomes the normal way
items.why: "after a few weeks, the new way becomes the normal way."

items.q: What helps during change?
items.why: "A positive attitude helps."

items.q: What does the text say 'goes a long way' during change?
items.why: "A small smile goes a long way during change."

audio.text:
The team is getting a new software tool next week, and some people are nervous. That's normal. My job today is to help everyone feel okay about the change. So I'll stay calm and listen.

First, I understand the worry. The old tool works, everyone knows it, and the new one feels slow at first. I won't pretend that's not real. 'Yes, the first week will feel slower. That's normal for any new tool.'

Then, the good news, honestly. 'But the new tool will save us about an hour a day once we know it. In a month, none of us will want to go back.'

And I'll listen to every concern. If someone says 'I don't understand the new screen', I don't say 'it's easy'. I say 'let's look at it together'. People accept change much better when they feel heard.

Change is going to happen anyway. My job isn't to force it — it's to make it feel safe. Ask questions, try it, help each other. A calm start makes a smooth change.

items.q: What is the team getting next week?
items.why: "The team is getting a new software tool next week."

items.q: How does James handle the team's worry?
options: He understands it and doesn't pretend it's not real
items.why: "I won't pretend that's not real. 'Yes, the first week will feel slower.'"

items.q: What is the honest good news?
options: It will save about an hour a day once they know it
items.why: "the new tool will save us about an hour a day once we know it."

items.q: When someone says 'I don't understand the new screen', what does James say?
items.why: "I say 'let's look at it together'. People accept change much better when they feel heard."

items.q: What does James say his job is?
items.why: "My job isn't to force it — it's to make it feel safe."

items.q: A **process** is…
options: a way of doing something, step by step
items.why: Process = processo.

items.q: To **adapt** means to…
items.why: Adapt = adaptar-se.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "At first, the new tool feels **___**."
items.why: Uncomfortable = desconfortável.

items.q: A **positive** attitude is…
items.why: Positive = positivo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let's **___** the new tool before we judge it."
items.why: Try = experimentar.

items.q: "A small smile **goes a long way**." To go a long way means to…
items.why: Go a long way = fazer muita diferença.

items.q: "None of us will want to **go back**." To go back means to…
items.why: Go back = voltar (ao antigo).

items.q: "People accept change when they feel **heard**." To feel heard means to…
options: feel that others listened to you
items.why: Feel heard = sentir-se ouvido.

items.q: "Let's **look at it together**." This offer means to…
items.why: Look at it together = ver juntos, ajudar.

items.q: "A calm start makes a **smooth** change." Smooth means…
items.why: Smooth = tranquilo, sem atritos.
